messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: Mentors: You need invitations this year!
parts:
R GSoC Mentors,

Google has changed the system we will use for administering GSoC this
year.

It is now here:

https://summerofcode.withgoogle.com/

They have also changed the way mentors are approved. In the past, you
would request to be a mentor, and the Org Admins would approve. This
year, we must invite mentors.

I will go through the R project ideas listed here:
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2016/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects

and invite all mentors who have email addresses on the project ideas
pages.

I notice that some mentors do not list their emails on the project ideas
page. It's not clear how you expect to communicate with students if
they cannot find you. I also cannot invite you.

If your project idea is not in the table, I will not invite you.

Please feel free to route any questions to this list, me, Toby, or
Virgilio.

Regards,

Brian


--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/
Ph: 773-459-4973
IM: bgpbraverock

messages.author: b98e21751c27e8b9
messages.subject: [Fwd: Mentors: You need invitations this year!]
parts:
I've added every mentor I have an email address for to the Google invite
list.

If you think you should have received an invitation from me and did not,
please send either me or this list an email with a link to your project
idea and your query.

If you hope to be a mentor for GSoC 2016, you need to get your project
idea on the wiki if it is not there already, or your email address
linked to your project idea in some way (direct or via a redirect
somewhere like github).

If your project idea is not on the wiki, you will not get an invitation.

There are only a few times during the GSoC calendar where timing is
critical. This is one of them. Student applications open March 14th,
Monday.

Regards,

Brian

--
Brian G. Peterson
http://braverock.com/brian/
Ph: 773-459-4973
IM: bgpbraverock
